narr: An upper level storm system brough scattered strong to severe storms that produced large hail, wind damage, and flash flooding for areas near and west of I-35 on both the 7th and 8th. The largest observed hail was the size of golf balls and was reported in Young County.
ev: Southwest of Cisco, CR 145 and CR 187 were closed due to flooding.
A home was reported as flooded near the Jack/Wise County line off of US Hwy 380.
A home was reported as flooded in the 2000 block of Dark Corner Road. This location is south of US Hwy 380, about half way between Bryson and Jacksboro.
The Sunset VFD reported flooding on State Hwy 101 near the Big Sandy Creek Bridge.
Nocona Hills VFD conducted a high water rescue on Rivercrest Drive near Lake Nocona.
A few mPING reports of street flooding and road closures were reported in Temple.
